notice: FICTIONAL TRAINING DATA ONLY. All holdings, people, outlines, crops, claims, notices, observations and sample documents are authored examples, not real farms, official LPIS parcels, ownership, protected-area designations or satellite/AMS results. Dates are fictional scenario inputs, not verified national deadlines. Approximate areas must be derived from the WGS84 outlines by the app, not treated as surveyed or CAP-eligible area. No application, amendment, receipt or acceptance is seeded. Every new fact, activity and field change requires separate human review. Workspace adviser access is not a government mandate.

scenarios.title: FICTIONAL — a Cáceres pasture claim needs checking
scenarios.summary: A fictional sheep farmer has one 6.70 ha physical pasture parcel. The authored SIGPAC-style reference supplies a 45% pasture coefficient and a rounded 3.02 ha claimable figure, leaving a 3.68 ha difference from the physical area. These supplied training values are not verified eligibility or payment decisions. Keep the whole physical outline: a coefficient does not locate a contiguous subpolygon.
scenarios.farmer_goal: Understand why the original 6.70 ha claim differs from the supplied 3.02 ha figure; choose what to review instead of blindly copying an area.
scenarios.adviser_goal: Review the original statement, the supplied pasture coefficient and evidence for any SIGPAC allegation; distinguish physical area, supplied claimable area and the authority's decision.
expected_actions: Open the original statement and the supplied reference; all four prefilled facts are unconfirmed until separately reviewed.

Compare the 6.70 ha claimed figure with the supplied 3.02 ha maximum and 45% coefficient. The arithmetic is 6.70 × 45% = 3.015 ha, displayed as 3.02 ha; 6.70 − 3.02 = 3.68 ha is a rounded difference, not a mapped excluded area or a penalty.
Option A: review a proposed future claim of 3.02 ha separately from the original statement. The original claimed 6.70 ha remains intact; checking a proposal does not mean it has been filed.

Option B: the fictional farmer says scrub was cleared last winter. Prepare a SIGPAC allegation only after checking dated geotagged photos, a lease or other actual land-use evidence and the current official route. No photos, lease or authority decision are seeded.
Keep the physical 6.70 ha outline unchanged. A 45% coefficient is not a command to shrink it, nor proof of a contiguous 55% exclusion.
Check any protected-area designation and applicable conditions separately. No real Natura 2000 intersection or automatic ineligibility is established.
National amendment deadlines, AMS regime, control stage and official acceptance remain unknown. Review every prefilled answer and selected source before any manual handoff.
